table.retrieve:
select  	code1=cstatus.acccode, 
			name1=ac.name, 
			value1=cstatus.opbalance, 
			value2=cstatus.debits,
			value3=cstatus.credits,
			areacode=ar.areacode,
			area=ar.name
from accounts ac, customer c, area ar, 
(select acccode, sum(opbalance) as opbalance, sum(debits) as debits, 
	sum(credits) as credits, sum(clbalance) as clbalance
	from 
		(select acccode, opbalance = sum(debit - credit), debits = 0, credits = 0, clbalance = 0
		from virtualgl
		where date < :ar_startdate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
		group by acccode
		union all
		select acccode, opbalance =0, debits=sum(debit), credits=sum(credit), clbalance=0
		from virtualgl
		where date >= :ar_startdate and date <= :ar_enddate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
		group by acccode
		union all
		select acccode, opbalance=0, debits=0, credits=0, clbalance = sum(debit - credit)
		from virtualgl
		where date <= :ar_enddate and acccode in (select acccode from accounts where subcode = 3)
		group by acccode) a
group by a.acccode) cstatus
where ac.subcode = 3 and ac.acccode = cstatus.acccode and 
		ac.acccode = c.custcode and 
		c.areacode in (:ar_areas) and
		c.areacode=ar.areacode
ORDER BY ar.name, ar.areacode, name1, code1

objects.name: c_closingdebit
objects.expression: if((value1  +  value2  -  value3)>=0 , value1  +  value2  -  value3 , 0)

objects.name: c_closingcredit
objects.expression: abs(if((value1  +  value2  -  value3)<0 , value1  +  value2  -  value3 , 0))
